decisions.reason: As a flagship organic line that has stayed visible on the website in both years, it meets the firm's aspiration for its organic expansion, and the firm's growth and hiring indicate enough slack to keep supporting it.
The premium snack line was extended with new variants in 2024, which signals satisfactory results, although it dropped from its own page to a mention, which adds some uncertainty.
This newly launched organic sausage fits the firm's strategic direction and has had too little time to fall short of aspirations, and a growing industry gives the firm slack to carry it.
This new organic product line with several variants matches the firm's organic focus and still has uncertain results that the firm's slack allows it to carry.
This organic salami variant is close to the core offer and new on the market, so there is no clear shortfall yet, though single niche variants like the dropped Product B are more easily cut.
